plain_text:
Alternatively, the image may be added to the document after it has been converted to a PDF file using Adobe Reader
(or equivalent). This can be done by copying the image from your original file. Once you have converted the Word
template to PDF select “Edit” then right-click in the pdf file in Adobe Reader (or equivalent) and select the “Paste”
option. You may have to zoom out to shrink the page down to resize the image to fit the page. Adjust the image size
by clicking on the corners of the image and dragging them to make the image the size you need it to be.
